protocol.writer: frozen; Memory construction has no gradient
protocol.trainable: L3 memory_read, fusion gate, FFN, norm2, and output head
protocol.all_key_branch: every stored Memory is queried once for every Key
protocol.control_branch: one random Key per Memory repeated to equal query rows
protocol.primary: strict per-key and Holm-corrected query-switch confirmation
protocol.paired_queries: identical query except one Key token
